reviews.text: Asked has been grooming Monty for years now and we wouldn't take him anywhere else 😊
Great new premises and our dog looked amazing after her groom. Would definitely recommend Alex who is great with CiCi too
Fabulous Service. Lucy loves her pamper time

Alex is the most caring and professional dog groomer you can imagine! Not only considerate with a puppy who was apprehensive about his groom but very informative and supportive with how we need to help with his grooming needs to get him used to being handled. She definitely goes over and above and in a really friendly and caring manner. So pleased we have booked Alex and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend to others!
Alex my dog groomer is a lovely person ,she has loads of time to play with scully my dog.he his in good hands and looks perfectly groomed when i pick him up.x

Alex was patient and reassuring with Cooper. She is meticulous. How she managed to produce such amazing results with such a wriggly boy I have no idea but he looked amazing. Her patience has meant he is gradually getting used to being groomed.
Another fabulous groom at Teddy Lancaster (in their fantastic new location) for our lovely six-year-old Cavapoo, Rosie. We highly recommend it!
Excellent groomer very patient with my little dog who is very anxious when being groomed. I would recommend.
Great service as always. Very knowledgable on what our dog needs at the right time in terms of looking after his coat, can’t recommend Alex enough 👍🏼 …
All good. We've got a nervy cockapoo and Alex looks after her really well.

Alex is a true dog lover and treats my furbaby with care and love.  Always tries to accommodate any requests and is fantastic at her job.  Millie always looks and smells great after her pampers sessions.
Alex is amazing and my dogs always look beautiful when we collect them. She does a fabulous job especially when one of my dogs isn't the easiest to groom as she's a little loopy. Highly recommend.🐶 …

Alex was very professional and caring towards grooming our little puppy Nico for the first time, Nico was given the luxury of a meet and greet before having his first groom, we couldn't be happier and now have Nico booked in for the foreseeable future. Highly recommended.
Thanks Alex. Would highly recommended these guys x
Alex as such a dog centred approach ,accommodating the dogs for there personal need to make sure every visit is a positive one highly recommend !
Alex is the best! Would highly recommend. She always takes the best care of my dog and he has truly never looked better!!

Alex does a brilliant job with my goldendoodle, Timmy. More than that, she is kind and caring with him, so he loves going there. She also gives very good advice on looking after his coat in between grooms. I highly recommend her.

Alex always does such an amazing professional groom on Monty our miniature Schnauzer.
Would highly recommend.

Betty has just had her 3rd visit and is happy after her groom. Alex has spent time building a trusting relationship with her. I have found Alex to be very helpful and informative in the advice she has given me. I would highly recommend Alex as I feel she loves dogs and offers a professional service.
Thank you Jake :)
